visualReview.notes: Inspected54 current frames:12 portable,12 shared-material/flat-map and30 Earth-rig/native-field/tier views. The598.246m single-track viaduct has paired deep open X-lattice side trusses,nine reconstructed spans,eight recessed pale tapered piers,caps/bearings and broad footings. Top railway rails and timber sleepers remain separate from the lower current visitor route;maintenance walks,visitor rails,overhead transverse braces,near flange strips/gussets and approximate end stair flights are present. Master retains denser sleepers,open grating and stylized rivet heads. No missing side panels:the steelwork is intentionally open. Fine safety mesh and original exact equipment are simplified. Skyline aggregates both side trusses into one central open plane within the3m allowance;district has two coarser trusses;street/close-up restore full panel rhythm. Three existing256px concrete,metal and wood graphs share texture memory;no private or embedded images. Six GLBs pass format validation and four focused tests prove byte reconstruction,actual lattice apertures,track/path continuity,native foundation embedding and actual railway-bridge replacement while preserving the lower Tilto street. Signed exact OSM/Q6707743 footprint and PMTiles railway agree within0.3m laterally. The129x129/6m grid is an unmodified ordinary viewer DEM,not a survey. Rail reference42.5m over the66m datum preserves picture proportions,but coarse bank-edge ground returns are14–15m lower;rail-bed crests,external approaches and absolute rail grades remain approximate. No native-ground endpoint claim or exact span schedule is made. High-mode shallow-member shadow faceting and approximate stair/rail detail remain visible limitations. Physical device timing is unmeasured.

siteIntegrationReview.source: Standard viewer PMTiles and ordinary global Terrarium tiles;no bespoke survey/terrain source.
siteIntegrationReview.notes: Unmodified129x129/6m field;foundations and abutments embed. Approximate rail reference108.5m absolute;coarse DEM bank returns14–15m below it. Native fixture preserves those returns and does not certify rail-bed crests/external rail grades. No flattening,water rectangle or invented embankment. Nine equal spans/eight pier stations are picture reconstructions.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four authored browser tiers;at most three draws;three shared texture graphs;no embedded/private images;separate position/normal streams. Detailed source remains separate. Physical-device timing unmeasured.
